pack.name: Barkham Horror: The Meddling of Meowlathotep

verificationSources.scope: Official product identity, 78 full-size cards, restrictions and scenario format.
Published scans of investigator, signature and player cards, plus encounter previews.

normalizationNotes: All 62 source definitions retained, including five hidden miniature investigator records linked with duplicate_of; the 78-card advertised product count excludes miniatures.
Greek OCTGN glyphs converted to ArkhamDB icon tokens. Enemy combat/agility mapped to enemy_fight/enemy_evade; per-investigator values preserve flags.
Revealed location alternate sides mapped to main text, shroud, clues and victory to follow the existing Card schema; all investigator, act, agenda and scenario backs preserved.
All Barkham content is restricted to the standalone Barkham scenario. No official preconstructed deck recipes are supplied by this product.
Artwork-dependent deckbuilding rules remain in the printed back_text, with structured deck_options recording only unambiguous faction/level rules; manual eligibility checks are necessary.
External scan URLs identify available art. No card-image files are included in this supplement.
Card content remains property of Fantasy Flight Games.

verifiedCorrections.reason: Each printed signature card has one wild icon omitted in the OCTGN XML.
Printed Hair of the Dog has four wild icons omitted in the XML.
Printed Dog Monocle soak values omitted in the XML.
Printed title is plural, including its references in the investigator deckbuilding requirements.
Printed Duke restriction says ABSOLUTELY NO CATS UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES; XML incorrectly says CARDS.

Obvious spelling/transcription errors normalized, including Discombobulator, returning, Spiked Collar, Footwear, Servant, Hunted by Byakats, Meowlathotep, off and the willpower icon. Names/icon mappings preserve intended printed mechanics.
Printed scans clarify Dogcatchers's possessive spelling and that Howl of Clyhf'ford targets the highest-evade enemy in play.
